name: Quote Keeper
office_task: Keep every quote we send on the register and follow each quiet customer up on our cadence and in our wording until they decide, then hand a no, a dispute or the cap to a person.
systems_of_record: the job system that issues the quote_id and job_id (ServiceM8, Simpro, or for Tradify a register kept beside it)
the exception desk the business runs (a sheet or a task list that issues the exception_id)

emits.write: the arrival that ends the chase, filed against the job the quote belongs to by its job_id: the customer's signed acceptance or reply by message_id, or the decision recorded on the call; the open item moves to arrived and is never touched again
emits.readback: reading the job by its job_id returns the filed attachment or note with its message_id or outcome id and the quote_id; nothing on the read-back means it was not filed, and the item stays open for a person rather than being chased

emits.write: an exception on the quote naming the person who owns it, with every touch so far: a no on the call, a dispute or a stop request, or the cadence's cap reached with no decision
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns the quote_id, the reason, the touch history and the exception_owner; no id back means nothing was raised and the run stops

port_of.original_name: The Follow-Up Machine — Quotes Don't Die in the Inbox Anymore
